quarterly_data.quarter: Sivers Semiconductors press release: Strategic LiDAR Customer Initiates Production Orders with (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sivers' strategic LiDAR customer initiated production orders for its automotive and industrial sensing customers: Sivers will supply the continuous-wave distributed feedback (CW DFB) lasers and optical amplifiers for the customer's LiDAR platforms, with shipments beginning in Q4 2026 against rolling production orders as the programs move into production in 2027. As announced in March 2026, the program's estimated cumulative revenue potential is USD 53 million to USD 138 million over the customer's product lifecycle.
quarterly_data.figure: shipments from Q4 2026; USD 53 million to USD 138 million lifecycle revenue potential
